watch.summary: The creator reacts with amusement to the meta-irony of watching fictional in-game advertisements play on a TV inside GTA 6 footage.

beats.what: A satirical commercial starts playing on the in-game television.
The creator points out the absurdity of watching an ad inside a game within a video clip.
The over-the-top sandwich advertisement concludes with absurd stacking animation.
The creator laughs out loud at the ridiculousness of the in-game ad.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: not us getting an ad within a video game on an ad-riddled Netflix
watch.why: The comedy stems from the absurd layers of meta-advertising within the GTA universe. The creator's amused commentary highlights the ironic experience of watching a commercial inside a commercial.
